findings.title: preStop hook outlasts the termination grace period
findings.cause: container web's preStop hook waits 45 s, and the pod's terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 30: the grace period includes the hook, so when the pod is deleted the kubelet kills the container before the app gets SIGTERM and time to finish, on every rollout, scale-down and drain; Deployment web has 1 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web's preStop hook and the pod's terminationGracePeriodSeconds

findings.fix: Set terminationGracePeriodSeconds above the preStop wait plus the app's own shutdown time (for example 75), or shorten the preStop sleep.
